split_policy.train: Use records whose split field is train.
split_policy.dev: Use only for hyperparameter selection, temperature scaling, review thresholds, and Tie policy.
split_policy.test: Reserved for final evaluation; never used for threshold or policy selection.

model_structure.positioning: Bias-aware and evidence-augmented judge calibration framework built on real M-Prometheus-3B outputs; not a fine-tuned LLM.

features: real M-Prometheus-3B base scores, score margin, and predicted-label indicators
answer length, sentence, bullet, numeric and overlap differences
bias indicators and bias-risk features for position, length, format and rubric sensitivity
dataset, task and scoring-system one-hot features
dev-selected pairwise Tie policy and review threshold

factuality.active_label_policy: Train only labels present in train/dev to avoid penalizing absent classes.
features: prompt, context, reference and answer length statistics
deterministic evidence features: sentence support, numeric/date/entity gaps, negation/comparative mismatch, support delta and evidence risk
dataset, task and scoring-system one-hot features
audit_only_features: low-support anchored entity/date/numeric gap diagnostics are retained for evidence subtype reporting but excluded from the formal factuality head.

model_structure.classifier: Task-specific softmax classifiers with standardized numeric features.

post_selection_calibration.method: Temperature scaling selected on dev NLL + ECE + 0.25*Brier.
post_selection_calibration.review_policy: Low-confidence review threshold selected on dev.

do_claim: Evidence augmentation is the main factuality reliability contribution.
Calibration and Tie policy improve pairwise decision stability.
Bias profiling supports risk control and review prioritization.
do_not_claim: BEA-Judge fine-tunes or trains a new large language judge.
The bias module significantly improves overall accuracy.
RAGTruth is solved at atomic-claim verification granularity.
Heuristic fallback contributes to formal SCI results.
